extDescription.message: Hands ymd, on this computer, the cookies of the sites you choose so it downloads with your session.

errorHostNotFound.message: ymd is not installed or has not registered the bridge.

errorHostNotFoundHint.message: Install ymd and open it once: it registers the bridge by itself. Then press “Send now”.

errorForbidden.message: ymd does not recognize this extension.

errorForbiddenHint.message: Load the extension from the folder ymd shows in Settings → Accounts.

errorHostFailedHint.message: Try again. If it keeps happening, update ymd.

errorRejected.message: ymd could not save the cookies ($CODE$).

errorRejectedHint.message: Try again. If it keeps happening, check ymd.

sitesEmpty.message: No sites yet. Add the sites you sign in to.

addInvalid.message: Enter just the domain, for example vimeo.com.

addDenied.message: Without the browser's permission the cookies of $DOMAIN$ can't be read.

addShared.message: $DOMAIN$ is shared by many sites. Type the specific site, for example user.github.io.

privacyNote.message: Cookies only travel to ymd on this computer, never over the network. Only from the sites on the list.

sessionClosed.message: Signed out: sign in to YouTube

badgeSessionClosed.message: ymd Cookies: you're signed out of YouTube

currentAdded.message: Done: ymd will get your $SITE$ session.

welcomeLead.message: It hands ymd, on this computer, the cookies of the sites you choose, so it downloads with your session. Two steps and you're done.

welcomePinHeading.message: Pin the extension to the toolbar

welcomePinBody.message: Click the extensions icon (the puzzle piece next to the address bar), then the pin next to ymd Cookies. That way you can tell at a glance whether your session reaches ymd.

welcomeSitesBody.message: The extension only sends the cookies of the sites on your list. The browser asks for permission for each site you add.

welcomeYoutubeReady.message: YouTube is ready: ymd will get your session once you sign in in this browser.

welcomeDone.message: You can close this tab. To change your sites later, open ymd Cookies from the toolbar.

commandDownload.message: Download the current page with ymd
